title: General Motors, LLC: WHEELS:SINGLE (197 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED VEHICLES FAIL TO CONFORM TO FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 120, "TIRE SELECTION AND RIMS FOR VEHICLES OTHER THAN PASSENGER CARS". SOME OF THE TIRES (ALCOA TUBE TYPE) WERE IMPROPERLY MARKED 22.5 X 7.5/5 WHEN THEY WERE MEANT TO BE 22 X 7.5/5.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): POWER TRAIN:AXLE ASSEMBLY:SHAFT AXLE (3,310 affected)
summary: A HALF SHAFT ASSEMBLY ON THE RIGHT OR LEFT SIDE OF THE FRONT WHEEL DRIVE MECHANISM MAY DEVELOP A FRACTURE NEAR ITS INBOARD ATTACHMENT POINT.

title: Ford Motor Company: WHEELS:MULTIPLE (700 affected)
summary: THE CAST HUBS ON SOME OF THE INVOLVED VEHICLES WERE IMPROPERLY MANUFACTURED. THEY MAY BE SUBJECT TO HIGH MILEAGE FATIGUE CRACKS AT THE INNER BEARING AREA OR ALONG THE FLANGE PORTIONS TO WHICH THE WHEELS ARE MOUNTED.

title: AMERICAN GARELLI EAST,LTD: VISUAL SYSTEMS:MIRRORS:REARVIEW:EXTERIOR (12,578 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED VEHICLES ARE EQUIPPED WITH A MIRROR THAT IS LESS THAN 12.5 SQUARE INCHES IN REFLECTIVE SURFACE AREA OR THE MIRROR MAY HAVE BEEN OMITTED ENTIRELY. THIS CONSTITUTES A NON-COMPLIANCE TO FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 111, "REARVIEW MIRRORS".

title: AMERICAN GARELLI EAST,LTD: EQUIPMENT:TIRE RESERVE LOAD LABEL (GLOVE COMPARTME (4,629 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED VEHICLES ARE NOT EQUIPPED WITH THE PROPER LABELS STATING TIRE, RIM AND INFLATION INFORMATION. THIS CONSTITUTES A NON-COMPLIANCE TO FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 120, "TIRE SELECTION AND RIMS FOR MOTOR VEHICLES OTHER THAN PASSENGER CARS".

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC (6,617 affected)
summary: THE FRONT BRAKE HOSE ROUTING ON THE INVOLVED VEHICLES MAY ALLOW INTERFERENCE BETWEEN THE HOSES AND THE FRONT TIRES DURING EXTREME TURNING ANGLES.

title: VETTER: LIGHTING:GENERAL OR UNKNOWN COMPONENT:HEAD LIGHTS (3,989 affected)
summary: THE MATERIAL USED FOR THE HEADLIGHT CHROME RING RETAINING BLADE OF THE HEADLIGHT NACELLE IS WEAK. AS A RESULT, THE OUTSIDE RING MAY VIBRATE FREE AND ALLOW THE HEADLIGHT TO FALL FROM THE FAIRING.

title: General Motors, LLC: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:CONTROL ARM (227 affected)
summary: THE BOLTS THAT ATTACHED THE REAR SUSPENSION CONTROL ARMS TO THE FRAME AND AXLE MAY BE DEFECTIVE AND THE BOLT HEAD MAY SEPARATE FROM THE BOLT SHANK. THIS COULD ALLOW THE CONTROL ARM TO COME LOOSE.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: BRAKES:AIR:DRUM AND SHOE SYSTEMS:ADJUSTERS:SLACK (300 affected)
summary: DUE TO DEFECTIVE INSTALLATION PROCEDURES ON THE INVOLVED VEHICLES, THERE IS A POSSIBILITY OF SLACK ADJUSTER DAMAGE. THIS COULD RESULT IN BRAKE FAILURE ON THE REAR WHEEL END.

title: WAGNER: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:MASTER CYLINDER (1,500 affected)
summary: THE LOCK WIRE GROOVE IN THE BRAKE MASTER CYLINDER WAS IMPROPERLY MACHINED. THIS COULD LEAD TO BRAKE FAILURE.

title: UNIROYAL GOODRICH TIRE CO: TIRES:TREAD (48 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED TIRES FAIL TO MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 119, "NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES FOR VEHICLES OTHER THAN PASSENGER CARS". AFTER 47 HOURS OF THE ENDURANCE TEST, THE TIRES EXHIBITED TREAD TIE-BAR TEARING AND GROVE CRACKING TO THE CARCASS CORDS.

title: SAAB CARS USA, INC.: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL (61,739 affected)
summary: UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS SUCH AS AMBIENT HUMIDITY AND VEHICLE PRE-CONDITIONING BY REPEATED COLD START, AND SHORT TRIP DRIVING CYCLES IN COMBINATION WITH SUB-ZERO TEMPERATURES, THERE EXISTS THE POSSIBILITY FOR ICE TO FORM IN THE THROTTLE HOUSING AND TEMPORARILY IMPEDE FULL CLOSURE OF THE THROTTLE PLATE WHEN THE ACCELERATOR IS RELEASED. THIS ICE BUILD-UP IN THE THROTTLE HOUSING MAY CAUSE HESITATION IN VEHICLE DECELERATION AND INCREASED STOPPING DISTANCES.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS:WINDSHIELD (5,300 affected)
summary: THE WINDSHIELD ON THE INVOLVED VEHICLES COULD UNSEAT AND BLOW INTO THE CAB OF THE TRUCK.

title: HUTCHENS INDUSTRIES, INC.: SUSPENSION:AXLE UNKNOWN NON-POWER (40 affected)
summary: STEEL USED IN MANUFACTURING ROCKER BEAMS AND SLIDER SUB-FRAMES FOR THE INVOLVED TRAILERS MAY HAVE BEEN OF SUB-STANDARD QUALITY. THESE PARTS COULD BECOME BRITTLE AND FRACTURE, ESPECIALLY IN COLD WEATHER.

title: Ford Motor Company: WHEELS:SINGLE (40,000 affected)
summary: A NUMBER OF WHEEL ASSEMBLIES ON THE INVOLVED VEHICLES MAY HAVE SUBSTANDARD WELDS IN THE AREA WHERE THE DISC IS ATTACHED TO THE RIM. SUBSTANDARD WELDS CAN CAUSE CRACKS TO OCCUR IN THE WHEEL ASSEMBLY. RAPID LOSS OF AIR PRESSURE IN THE TIRE OR SEPARATION OF THE WHEEL RIM FROM THE DISC COULD RESULT.

title: Cooper Tire & Rubber Co.: TIRES:TREAD (4,439 affected)
summary: TIRES FAIL TO MEET THE ENDURANCE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD N0. 109, "NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES". TIRES MAY DEVELOP TREAD SEPARATION AND CONTINUED USE MAY CAUSE THE PLY CORDS TO BREAK.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: FUEL:FUEL CARBURETION (130 affected)
summary: DUE TO THE OPERATION OF THE DUAL FUEL OPTION THERE EXISTS THE POTENTIAL FOR BACKFIRE THROUGH THE CARBURETOR. THIS CAN CAUSE CARBURETOR DAMAGE DUE TO EXCESSIVE PRESSURES. ALSO, FUEL LEAKAGE COULD OCCUR WHEN THE SYSTEM IS REVERTING TO GASOLINE FUEL OPERATION.

title: Ford Motor Company: LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:HEAD LIGHTS (92,200 affected)
summary: THE HEADLAMP SWITCHES ON THE INVOLVED VEHICLES MAY FAIL WITHOUT WARNING AND CAUSE LOSS OF VEHICLE INSTRUMENT AND ROAD LIGHTS.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: BRAKES:AIR:CYLINDER WHEEL:CAM:ACTUATING (25,000 affected)
summary: AS A RESULT OF SEVERE SHOCK AND VIBRATIONS, THE BRAKE SPIDERS ON THE INVOLVED VEHICLES MAY DEVELOP CRACKS NEAR THE CAMSHAFT MOUNTING BOSS. THE CRACK PROPAGATES ACROSS THE SPIDER UNTIL THE CAMSHAFT BOSS IS COMPLETELY SEVERED FROM THE REMAINDER OF THE SPIDER. WHEN THE CAMSHAFT BOSS HAS COMPLETELY SEVERED, THE S-CAM, S-CAM BRACKET, AIR CHAMBER AND SLACK ADJUSTER CAN FALL AWAY FROM THE BRAKE SPIDER RESULTING IN A "NO BRAKE" CONDITION ON THE WHEEL.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: FUEL:FUEL EMISSION CONTROL (2,950 affected)
summary: THE FUEL SEPARATORS ON THE INVOLVED VEHICLES MAY HAVE THIN WALLS DUE TO A MATERIAL THICKNESS PROBLEM. THE SEPARATORS IN THESE WALLS MAY CRACK AND MAY ALLOW FUEL VAPORS OR LIQUID FUEL TO LEAK INTO THE ENGINE UNDER HIGH PRESSURE CONDITIONS.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL:PEDAL (7,500 affected)
summary: THE DEFECT IS IN THE ENGINE ACCELERATOR SYSTEM. THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL MAY NOT ALIGN WITH THE CENTER OF THE FLOOR MOUNTED PEDAL STOP BRACKET. THE POTENTIAL EXISTS FOR THE PEDAL, WHEN DEPRESSED, TO SLIP OFF AND TO THE SIDE OF THE PEDAL STOP, HOLDING THE ACCELERATOR IN THE OPEN THROTTLE POSITION.

title: General Motors, LLC: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC:LEVER AND LINKA (55 affected)
summary: THE SHIFT CABLE RETAINING CLIP MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED BACKWARDS OR NOT AT ALL. THE PURPOSE OF THIS SPRING CLIP IS TO SECURE THE LOWER END OF THE SHIFT CABLE HOUSING TO THE TRANSMISSION. IF THE CLIP IS BACKWARD OR MISSING, THE CONSOLE SHIFT LEVER MAY NOT SHIFT THE TRANSMISSION AND/OR THE TRANSMISSION RANGE INDICATOR MAY INDICATE THAT THE TRANSMISSION IS IN THE "PARK" OR "P" POSITION WHEN IT IS NOT.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): STEERING:COLUMN COUPLING (31,000 affected)
summary: THE LOWER STEERING SHAFT COUPLING ON THE INVOLVED VEHICLES MAY HAVE AN OVERSIZED SERRATION DIAMETER IN THE ATTACHMENT AREA TO THE STEERING GEAR SHAFT. SINCE THIS OVERSIZED COUPLING MAY NOT BE ADEQUATELY ENGAGED ON THE STEERING GEAR SHAFT, THE ATTACHMENT MAY LOOSEN, RESULTING IN STEERING FREE PLAY.

title: PULLMAN, INCORPORATED: SUSPENSION:AXLE UNKNOWN:NON-POWER:SPRING ASSEMBLY (1,088 affected)
summary: THE BOTTOM PLATES, WHICH ARE LOCATED AT THE BOTTOM PART OF THE TRAILER AXLE, MAY FRACTURE DURING SEVERE OPERATION OF THE INVOLVED SEMI-TRAILERS. FRACTURE OF ONE OR MORE OF THESE BOTTOM PLATES ON A SINGLE AXLE COULD ALLOW THE TRAILER"S AXLE TO MOVE IN AN EITHER VERTICAL OR HORIZONTAL DIRECTION OPPOSITE TO THE DIRECTION OF THE TRACTOR TRAILER COMBINATION. THIS CONDITION WOULD NOT ALLOW FOR PROPER DIRECTIONAL CONTROL OF THE TRACTOR-TRAILER COMBINATION.

title: SHELLER-GLOBE CORPORATION: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:STARTER SOLENOID (175 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED UNITS MAY CONTAIN A DEFECTIVE SOLENOID WHICH CAN DETERIORATE IN SERVICE DUE TO MOISTURE BUILD UP FROM RAIN WATER AND OTHER EXTERNAL SOURCES.

title: Ford Motor Company: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:SWITCH:BRAKE LIGHT (3,100 affected)
summary: THE STOP LAMP SWITCH MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED IN A LOW PRESSURE PART OF THE HYDRAULIC BRAKE SYSTEM. CONSEQUENTLY, THERE MAY BE INSUFFICIENT PRESSURE TO ACTUATE THE LAMP SWITCH AND ILLUMINATE THE STOP LAMPS DURING LIGHT BRAKE APPLICATIONS.

title: General Motors, LLC: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC:COOLING UNIT AN (224,892 affected)
summary: THE AUTOMATIC COOLER LINE HOSES ON SOME OF THE SUSPECT VEHICLES MAY CONTAIN MATERIAL VOIDS, WHICH COMBINED WITH A HIGH THERMAL EXPANSION AT ELEVATED TEMPERATURES, COULD RESULT IN HOSE FAILURE AND TRANSMISSION FLUID LEAKAGE.

title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT RETRACTORS (517 affected)
summary: THE BRIDGE IN THE SEAT BELT BUCKLE LOCKING MECHANISM OF THE FRONT SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY MAY HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY BENT. THE BUCKLE MAY NOT HOLD PROPERLY AND WILL RELEASE, IF EXTREME FORCES ARE APPLIED.
